description: Invention candidates found in one whole document. An empty candidates array means the document holds no candidate.

candidates.description: At most 8 patentable invention candidates, strongest first. Empty when the document has none.

items.description: One invention candidate: a novel, non-obvious, useful technical idea the document discloses.

title.description: At most 12 words naming the invention as a concept. No identifiers, file names, section numbers, or trailing period.

summary.description: 2 to 3 sentences, at most 60 words: the technical problem, how the idea solves it, and the result. Own words, no location.

patentability_rationale.description: 1 to 2 sentences, at most 60 words: what looks new, why it is not an obvious step over the usual approach, and why it is useful. Hedged, never a legal conclusion.

excerpt_quote.description: At most 200 characters copied verbatim from the document on one line that best shows the idea, or null when no exact span fits. Never invented or edited.
